```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

A population identified set expresses structural ambiguity even with unlimited
data. A plug-in set replaces its inputs by estimates; it has no automatic
coverage interpretation. An honest outer set additionally propagates supplied
statistical uncertainty.

```{r}
library(TRSC)
g <- trsc_geometry(matrix(c(0, 1), 1, dimnames = list(NULL, c("A", "B"))))
X <- rbind(c(A = 0, B = 1), c(A = 0, B = 1))
level <- c(A = .5, B = .5)
previous <- c(A = .6, B = .4)
plugin <- trsc_counterfactual_set(g, X, level, q = 2, R = .1, previous = previous)
```

## Supplied certificates

These numbers are illustrative maintained bounds, not calibrated universal
constants. In an application they require an analytic derivation or independent
certificate. For q=2 the components bound the joint W norm.

```{r}
ac <- trsc_anchor_certificate(g, level, q = 2, previous = previous,
  W = matrix(c(2, .5, .5, 1), 2),
  components = c(estimation = .05, fitting_gap = .02, causal_gap = 0, numerical = 0),
  failure_probability = .02, source = "Toy maintained joint boundary bounds")
gc <- trsc_geometry_certificate(g, epsilon = .01, failure_probability = .01,
  source = "Toy maintained absolute norm comparison on ALL simplex chords")
outer <- trsc_confidence_set(X, ac, gc, q = 2, R = .1)
outer
trsc_bounds(plugin)
trsc_bounds(outer)
trsc_anchor_propagation(ac, 0:5)
```

Fitting-local calibration is insufficient for unrestricted future paths.
The future root-energy allowance is
\(2^{q-1}\sqrt{H}\epsilon_N\). Level and velocity share one probability
event; they are not treated as independent intervals.

```{r}
trsc_sensitivity(outer, c(0, .1, .3), c(1, 1))
endpoint <- trsc_confidence_support(outer, c(1, 1))
trsc_diagnostics(endpoint)
```

The same nuisance event covers all directions, horizons and radii for the
specified program. A finite candidate library needs simultaneous certificates;
pass it through `library=`. With covariance-only Markov control, equal
allocations can cost sqrt(M/alpha). No refit is covered.

Default probability statements concern a fixed deployment experiment or
unconditional random deployment. Conditional-on-realized-donors coverage needs
certificates with that conditional scope. A rank diagnostic is not a certificate.

## Numerical and causal boundaries

The reported upper endpoint is a validated dual/residual enclosure or a
donor-hull fallback. The approximate primal maximum is stored separately.
A certified gap is available only with a verified feasible primal witness.
Optimization certification does not verify the causal bridge.

```{r}
trsc_effect_interval(outer, c(1, 1), treated_mean_interval = c(2.9, 3.1),
                     mean_failure_probability = .01)
```

The treated input is a confidence interval for a conditional-mean functional,
not for a realized observation. The combined failure budget uses Bonferroni.
No realized individual treatment effect is identified by this translation.
